scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const d=p.join(__dirname,'dist');if(!fs.existsSync(p.join(d,'index.js'))){console.error('FATAL: packages/shared/dist/index.js missing');process.exit(1);}[p.resolve(__dirname,'../../node_modules/@crm/shared'),p.resolve(__dirname,'../../apps/api/node_modules/@crm/shared')].forEach(nm=>{if(fs.existsSync(nm)&&!fs.lstatSync(nm).isSymbolicLink()){fs.cpSync(d,p.join(nm,'dist'),{recursive:true});console.log('Synced dist to',nm);}});"
